description: Liste des points d'arrêt de bus du réseau IDELIS is a dataset listed in opendata.pau.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IDELIS. Points d'arrêts de bus du réseau IDELIS en fonctionnement. Coverage: Pau agglomeration. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are arrets, bus, idelis, topologie. The current IDELIS metadata API reports 822 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The current IDELIS metadata API reports a 2026-10-07 modification date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Current IDELIS metadata and landing-page routes were checked on 2026-10-08. The CSV endpoint returned HTTP 200 to HEAD. Caveat: distribution contents were not fetched. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-pau-fr-portal.
